sentences.text: The National Scheme for Compensation to Beedi Workers (NSCBRWK) is designed to provide financial assistance to beedi workers in India.
The objective of the scheme is to offer compensation to beedi workers who are unable to work due to health issues or accidents.
The benefits include financial assistance to the workers and their families in case of death or disability.
Eligibility criteria include being a registered beedi worker and meeting specific health and income conditions.
The application process involves submitting a form along with necessary documents to the designated authorities.
The timeline for disbursement of benefits is generally within a few weeks of application approval.
The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
Additional details regarding the exact amount of compensation and specific health conditions may vary and should be checked with local authorities.
